title: Canvas Assignment Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=canvas:assignment score_pct=*
| stats sum(score_pct) as total_value, avg(score_pct) as avg_value by course_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks course name values by total and average score across Canvas assignment events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `score_pct` values for each Canvas assignment event and review total and average score by course name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total score.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which course name shows the biggest score numbers in your Canvas assignment data.
